# Maps and script content

Read the relevant [pitch](../../design/PITCH.md), [map rules](../../design/MAP_DESIGN.md),
[balance](../../design/BALANCE.md), and [terms](../../design/TERMS.md).
Call existing [engine APIs](../../design/ENGINE_API.md), not private state internals.
Author new scripts in Poryscript, leaving generated `.inc` files untracked.

Exercise prerequisites, denied access, rewards only once, cancellation, reentry,
loss recovery, and save/load where relevant. Measure actual text and inspect
screenshots. Assisted battles prove progression, not balance.
Use [the validation matrix](../../design/ENGINEERING.md).
